 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. STILLWATER — Late Monday night, Eric Morris took a detour on his way home from Boone Pickens Stadium.
 Morris drove through Oklahoma State's campus. He wanted to see the preparations ahead of his first homecoming game as the Cowboys' head football coach.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement OSU hosts Colorado on Saturday (6 p.m., FS1).
 "Excited to see it later in the week," Morris said Tuesday. "Happy it's a night game to see Boone at night. They called it America's Greatest Homecoming, right?"
 Morris said he's got a lot of family coming to Stillwater for the game. He's focused on not letting all the festivities become a distraction.
 "There's a lot of commotion going on and I think it will be important to keep our guys focused on what's going to make the finale of homecoming and make everybody go home happy that night, is us winning the game against a really good Colorado team," Morris said.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Colorado leads the all-time series against OSU 27-20-1. The Buffaloes won the most recent 2024 matchup 52-0.

 05:30 PM ET, October 24 2026, Ben Hutchens 
 2026 Record: 2-4 overall, 0-3 Big 12
 Best player: Former Tulsa Golden Hurricane wide receiver Joseph Williams has had two 100-plus yard receiving games and ranks No. 4 in the Big 12 with 508 receiving yards this season. Williams has big-play potential and he even tossed a 49-yard pass against Baylor. Williams started his career at Tulsa in 2024 and has spent the past two seasons at Colorado.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The case for Colorado: Colorado has been competitive in all three of its Big 12 games. The Buffs were tied in the fourth quarter against Baylor, led TTU 7-3 at halftime and held a third-quarter lead against Utah. The Buffaloes do a decent job getting to quarterbacks (13 sacks tie for No. 6 in the Big 12) and could stay in the game with OSU if they can cause some havoc against a turnover-prone Cowboy quarterback Drew Mestemaker.
 The case for OSU: Colorado won't be able to score enough points to beat the Cowboys. Colorado is still searching for answers at quarterback. After benching 5-star quarterback Julian Lewis at halftime of the Baylor game, Sanders turned to junior Isaac Wilson who has thrown five interceptions and is completing 57.4% of his passes in three games as full-time quarterback. Colorado has been held under 15 points in four games.
